title: A hidden layer drops its page item
concept: Two Layers in the design map, one Visible and one not. Each filled Rectangle names its layer through ItemLayer; the renderer skips the item whose layer is hidden, so only one shape paints.

annotations.note: The "Front" layer with Visible="true". Its page items render normally.
The "Back" layer with Visible="false". Flip this to true and the blue rectangle reappears.
